method: one complete paired-contact illustration; relational opposite-contact control

attachments.role: internal pose planning; render to PNG before any authorized call

excludedReferences: all held F04 and selected033 F00: no pose inertia reference attached

fixedExtraction.regions: left [0,W/2) x [0,H), right [W/2,W) x [0,H); require even W
fixedExtraction.scale: s=128/max(W/2,H), same s for BOTH complete cells
fixedExtraction.padding: center both resized cells in 128x128 using same offsets; no bbox fit
fixedExtraction.presentation: whole 128 canvas displayed89; no per-frame fit/shift/rotation/mirror

toolCapability: aspect ratio is a prompt request only; actual builtin dimensions/control unknown, no pixel-lock guarantee
intake: one brief fixed89 pair look: genuine opposite forward/support legs, same direction and coherent whole identity; hold if neither pair reverses or clipping/pivot/scale failure is visible
laterGate: F2/F6/inbetweens/all directions/units/runtime/public remain CLOSED until parent actual pair intake
